faqs.q: How do I mark the popular plan?
faqs.a: Use the "Highlight tier" dropdown — that plan gets a scaled-up card, a badge, and the accent border.

faqs.q: Can I use a different currency?
faqs.a: Yes — just type any currency symbol or code into the price fields.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my site?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the embedded <style> block. All classes are prefixed with pt- to avoid conflicts.
